_readme.title: CSE Professional Reviewer — Question Bank
how_to_add_questions: Append question objects to the END of a topic's 'questions' array. Do not renumber existing questions.

Each question needs: id (unique across ALL topics, format topicid_N, use a number higher than any existing one), question (string), choices (exactly 4 DISTINCT strings), answer (integer 0-3), explanation (string).
Each session randomly picks up to 'required' questions per topic; the bank can be as large as you like.
To add a topic, append a new topic object {id, name, icon, required, questions} to the 'topics' array.
notes: v5.0: merged questions.json + questions_cleaned.json + questions_expanded.json; removed duplicates; fixed questions with identical choices or incorrect answers.

questions.question: Choose the word most similar in meaning to BENEVOLENT.
questions.explanation: BENEVOLENT means well-meaning and kindly. CHARITABLE is the closest synonym as it means generous in giving to those in need.

questions.question: Choose the word most OPPOSITE in meaning to LOQUACIOUS.
questions.explanation: LOQUACIOUS means very talkative. Its antonym is TACITURN, which means reserved or saying little.

questions.question: Select the correctly spelled word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is ACCOMMODATE — with double 'c' and double 'm'.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The committee _______ the proposal after a long debate.
questions.explanation: Past tense 'ratified' is correct since the action has already occurred.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
choices: Each of the students have their own locker.
Each of the students has their own locker.
Each of the students have his own locker.
Each of the students are having their own locker.
questions.explanation: 'Each' is a singular indefinite pronoun, so it takes a singular verb 'has'. Modern usage accepts 'their' as a gender-neutral singular pronoun.

questions.question: Choose the word most similar in meaning to EPHEMERAL.
questions.explanation: EPHEMERAL means lasting for a very short time. TRANSIENT is the closest synonym meaning passing quickly.

questions.question: Identify the error: 'Neither the manager nor the employees was informed about the change.'
questions.explanation: When using 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it ('employees' — plural). The correct verb should be 'were informed'.

questions.question: What does the idiom 'burn the midnight oil' mean?
choices: To work late into the night
questions.explanation: 'Burn the midnight oil' is an idiom meaning to work or study late into the night.

questions.question: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
questions.explanation: Conjunctive adverbs like 'however' used in the middle of a sentence must be set off by commas on both sides.

questions.question: The word 'PEDESTRIAN' when used as an adjective means:
questions.explanation: As an adjective, PEDESTRIAN means lacking inspiration or excitement; dull and ordinary.

questions.question: Choose the word most similar in meaning to AMBIGUOUS.
questions.explanation: AMBIGUOUS means open to more than one interpretation. VAGUE is the closest synonym, meaning not clearly expressed.

questions.question: Which is the correct passive voice of: 'The manager approved the report.'?
choices: The report was approved by the manager.
The report is approved by the manager.
The manager was approving the report.
The report has been approving by the manager.
questions.explanation: In passive voice, the object becomes the subject: 'The report was approved by the manager.'

questions.question: What does the idiom 'bite the bullet' mean?
choices: To endure a painful situation with courage
questions.explanation: 'Bite the bullet' means to endure a painful or difficult situation bravely.

questions.question: Select the correctly spelled word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is RECEIVE. 'i before e, except after c' — so it is 'cei' not 'cie'.

questions.question: Choose the word most OPPOSITE in meaning to FRUGAL.
questions.explanation: FRUGAL means being careful with money. Its antonym is EXTRAVAGANT, meaning spending much more than necessary.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: If I _______ the answer, I would tell you.
questions.explanation: This is a second conditional: if + simple past ('knew'), would + base verb.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the word 'affect' correctly?
choices: The new policy will effect all employees.
The new policy will affect all employees.
The new policy will be affected all employees.
The new policy affects to all employees.
questions.explanation: 'Affect' is a verb meaning to have an impact on something. 'The policy will affect employees' is correct.

questions.question: What is the meaning of the word VERBOSE?
questions.explanation: VERBOSE means using or containing more words than needed — unnecessarily wordy.

questions.question: Identify the correct sentence.
choices: Between you and I, this is a mistake.
Between you and me, this is a mistake.
Between you and myself, this is a mistake.
Between I and you, this is a mistake.
questions.explanation: After a preposition like 'between,' the objective case 'me' must be used, not 'I' or 'myself.'

questions.question: Choose the word most similar in meaning to DILIGENT.
questions.explanation: DILIGENT means having care and effort in one's work. INDUSTRIOUS is the closest synonym meaning hardworking.

questions.question: Which of the following is a dangling modifier?
choices: Running quickly, she caught the bus.
Having finished the report, the meeting was adjourned.
After studying all night, Maria passed the exam.
Confused by the question, the student raised his hand.
questions.explanation: In 'Having finished the report, the meeting was adjourned,' the modifier incorrectly modifies 'the meeting' instead of a person.

questions.question: Choose the antonym of CANDID.
questions.explanation: CANDID means truthful and straightforward. Its antonym is EVASIVE, meaning tending to avoid direct answers.

questions.question: What does 'a blessing in disguise' mean?
choices: Something that appears bad but turns out to be good
Something too good to be true
questions.explanation: 'A blessing in disguise' means something that seems bad at first but results in something good.

questions.question: Select the sentence with correct subject-verb agreement.
choices: The committee have made their decision.
questions.explanation: Fields of study like Mathematics are treated as singular nouns and take a singular verb. 'Mathematics is' is correct.

questions.question: The word OSTENTATIOUS most nearly means:
questions.explanation: OSTENTATIOUS means characterized by a showy display intended to impress others.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a conjunction?
questions.explanation: QUICKLY is an adverb. Although, Because, and Unless are all subordinating conjunctions.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: She is one of the employees who _______ always on time.
questions.explanation: The antecedent of 'who' is 'employees' (plural), so the verb must be plural: 'are.'

questions.question: What is the meaning of the word PRAGMATIC?
choices: Dealing with things sensibly and practically
questions.explanation: PRAGMATIC means dealing with things realistically rather than theoretically.

questions.question: Choose the correctly spelled word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is OCCURRENCE — double 'c' and double 'r'.

questions.question: Which sentence is written in the future perfect tense?
choices: She will finish the report tomorrow.
She will have finished the report by tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Future perfect tense is formed with 'will have + past participle.' It describes an action completed before a future point.

questions.question: Choose the word most similar in meaning to METICULOUS.
questions.explanation: METICULOUS means showing great attention to detail. THOROUGH is the closest synonym.

questions.question: Identify the sentence that uses the subjunctive mood correctly.
choices: I wish he will be here.
questions.explanation: The subjunctive mood uses 'were' (not 'was') for hypothetical or wishful situations: 'I wish he were here.'

questions.question: What is the meaning of the prefix 'ANTE-'?
questions.explanation: The prefix 'ANTE-' means before, as in 'antecedent' (something that comes before) or 'anteroom' (a room before the main room).

questions.question: Which sentence contains a misplaced modifier?
choices: She almost drove her kids to school every day.
He quickly ran to catch the bus.
The teacher explained the lesson clearly.
They quietly waited for the results.
questions.explanation: 'Almost' is misplaced — it modifies 'drove' instead of 'every day.' The intended meaning is 'She drove her kids to school almost every day.'

questions.question: The word UBIQUITOUS means:
choices: Present everywhere at the same time
questions.explanation: UBIQUITOUS means appearing or found everywhere. Example: Smartphones are ubiquitous in modern society.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the serial (Oxford) comma, as preferred in formal writing?
choices: We need to buy: milk eggs, and bread.
We need to buy milk, eggs and bread.
We need to buy milk, eggs, and bread.
We need to buy, milk, eggs, and bread.
questions.explanation: The serial comma goes before 'and' in a list: 'milk, eggs, and bread.'

questions.question: What is the antonym of VERBOSE?
questions.explanation: VERBOSE means using too many words. Its antonym is CONCISE, meaning giving a lot of information clearly in few words.

questions.question: Which of these is an example of onomatopoeia?
choices: The moon was a silver coin.
The brook babbled over the rocks.
The stars danced in the sky.
questions.explanation: 'Babbled' is an onomatopoeia — a word that phonetically imitates the sound it describes (the sound of water flowing).

questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'The datum _______ been verified.'
questions.explanation: 'Datum' is the singular of 'data', so it takes the singular verb 'has'.

questions.question: What literary device is used in: 'The classroom was a zoo.'?
questions.explanation: This is a METAPHOR — a direct comparison between two unlike things without using 'like' or 'as.' A simile would say 'like a zoo.'

questions.question: Choose the word most similar in meaning to ACUMEN.
questions.explanation: ACUMEN means the ability to make good judgments and quick decisions, typically in a particular domain. SHARPNESS is the closest synonym.

questions.question: Choose the word most OPPOSITE in meaning to COPIOUS.
questions.explanation: COPIOUS means abundant in supply or quantity. Its antonym is SCARCE, which means insufficient for the demand.

questions.question: Select the correctly spelled word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is CONSCIOUS — meaning aware of and responding to one's surroundings.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Neither the driver nor the passengers _______ injured in the accident.
questions.explanation: With 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the closer subject. 'Passengers' is plural, so the plural verb 'were' is correct.

questions.question: Identify the grammatically correct sentence.
questions.explanation: The adverb 'beautifully' correctly modifies the action verb 'sings'. In contrast, 'looks' in the second choice is a linking verb and requires an adjective ('looks beautiful').

questions.question: What does the idiom 'beat around the bush' mean?
choices: To clear a path in the woods
To avoid talking about the main topic directly
To achieve two things at once
questions.explanation: 'Beat around the bush' means to discuss a matter without coming to the point.

questions.question: Identify the error in the sentence: 'The collection of rare books were sold at the auction.'
questions.explanation: The subject of the sentence is the singular collective noun 'collection', not 'books'. Therefore, the verb should be singular: 'was sold'.

questions.question: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
choices: Marys coat was left in the car.
Mary's coat was left in the car.
Marys' coat was left in the car.
Mary coat was left in the car.
questions.explanation: To show singular possession for Mary, an apostrophe followed by an 's' is required.

questions.question: The word 'SURREPTITIOUS' most nearly means:
choices: Done by secret or stealthy means
questions.explanation: SURREPTITIOUS means kept secret, especially because it would not be approved of.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The team had to alter their plans _______ the bad weather.
questions.explanation: 'Due to' functions as a preposition meaning 'because of', which correctly introduces the noun phrase 'the bad weather'.

questions.question: What is the correct passive voice of: 'The chef prepared a delicious meal.'?
choices: A delicious meal is prepared by the chef.
A delicious meal was prepared by the chef.
The chef was preparing a delicious meal.
A delicious meal had been prepared by the chef.
questions.explanation: The original sentence is in the simple past tense. The passive construction must use 'was/were + past participle'.

questions.question: Choose the word most OPPOSITE in meaning to EPHEMERAL.
questions.explanation: EPHEMERAL means lasting for a very short time. PERPETUAL means never ending or changing, making it the direct antonym.

questions.question: Select the correctly spelled word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is MAINTENANCE. Note the 'ten' in the middle, unlike the verb 'maintain'.

questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates a correct conditional structure?
choices: If it rains, we would stay home.
If it rained, we will stay home.
If it rains, we will stay home.
If it will rain, we stay home.
questions.explanation: This is a first conditional sentence expressing a real future possibility: 'If + present simple, will + base verb'.

questions.question: What does the phrase 'at the eleventh hour' mean?
questions.explanation: 'At the eleventh hour' is an idiom that means at the last possible moment or right before it's too late.

questions.question: Choose the sentence with the correct use of a relative pronoun.
choices: The man which called you left a message.
The man whom called you left a message.
The man whose called you left a message.
The man who called you left a message.
questions.explanation: 'Who' is used as the subject pronoun referring to a person ('The man').

questions.question: Identify the dangling modifier in the choices below.
choices: While walking to work, a stray dog followed her.
While walking to work, she saw a stray dog.
She saw a stray dog while she was walking to work.
A stray dog followed her as she walked to work.
questions.explanation: In option A, the phrase 'While walking to work' modifies 'a stray dog' instead of the person doing the walking, making it a dangling modifier.

questions.question: Choose the word most similar in meaning to CANDID.
questions.explanation: CANDID means truthful and straightforward; frank.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to 'ADVERSE'.
questions.explanation: ADVERSE means unfavorable or harmful.

questions.question: Choose the antonym of 'MITIGATE'.
questions.explanation: MITIGATE means to make less severe; AGGRAVATE means to make worse.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly shows possession by one teacher?
questions.explanation: Singular possession takes apostrophe + s: 'teacher's lounge' (one teacher). 'Teachers' lounge' would belong to several teachers.

questions.question: Select the correctly spelled form of the word meaning awareness of right and wrong.
questions.explanation: CONSCIENCE is spelled c-o-n-s-c-i-e-n-c-e.

questions.question: What does the idiom 'to hit the nail on the head' mean?
choices: To describe exactly what is causing a situation
To finish a task too early
questions.explanation: The idiom means to identify or state something exactly.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: “The committee has reached ______ decision.”
questions.explanation: COMMITTEE is treated as a singular collective noun in this sentence, so the singular possessive pronoun ITS is appropriate.

questions.question: Select the sentence with parallel structure.
choices: She likes reading, to swim, and cycling.
She likes to read, swimming, and to cycle.
She likes reading, swimming, and cycling.
She likes read, swim, and cycling.
questions.explanation: The three items use the same -ing grammatical form.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to 'IMPARTIAL'.
questions.explanation: IMPARTIAL means fair and not favoring either side.

questions.question: Which is the best revision of the sentence: 'Due to the fact that it rained, the game was postponed.'?
choices: In view of the fact it rained, the game was postponed.
Because it rained, the game was postponed.
The game was postponed due to raining fact.
It rained, being the reason for postponement of the game.
questions.explanation: Because communicates the same idea more clearly and concisely.

questions.question: Which sentence is in the present perfect tense?
choices: They have visited the museum several times.
They are visiting the museum now.
They will visit the museum tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Present perfect uses has or have plus the past participle.

questions.question: Choose the antonym of 'OBSOLETE'.
questions.explanation: OBSOLETE means no longer in use; CURRENT is its opposite.

questions.question: Identify the adverb in the sentence: 'The applicant answered the questions confidently.'
questions.explanation: CONFIDENTLY modifies the verb answered and tells how the action was done.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a semicolon?
choices: The office was closed; because it was a holiday.
The office was closed; the staff had already gone home.
The office; was closed and empty.
The office was; closed for the day.
questions.explanation: A semicolon can join two closely related independent clauses.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to 'CREDIBLE'.
questions.explanation: CREDIBLE means capable of being believed or trusted.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: 'Neither of the proposals ______ acceptable.'
questions.explanation: Neither is treated as singular in this construction, so IS is appropriate.

questions.question: Which sentence uses 'who' correctly?
choices: Who did you give the file to?
Whom is responsible for this task?
The employee who submitted the report was thanked.
To who should I address the letter?
questions.explanation: WHO is the subject of the clause 'who submitted the report'. 'Whom is responsible' and 'To who' misuse the case.

questions.question: What does 'read between the lines' mean?
questions.explanation: The expression means to understand something that is suggested but not directly stated.

questions.question: In the sentence beginning 'After the meeting', which version uses the comma correctly?
choices: After the meeting we, submitted the minutes.
After the meeting, we submitted the minutes.
After, the meeting we submitted the minutes.
After the meeting we submitted, the minutes.
questions.explanation: An introductory phrase is normally followed by a comma.

questions.question: Choose the antonym of 'SCARCE'.
questions.explanation: SCARCE means insufficient or hard to find; ABUNDANT means plentiful.

questions.question: Which sentence expresses a conditional situation contrary to present fact?
choices: If I had time, I would join the seminar.
If I have time, I will join the seminar.
If I had had time, I would have joined.
When I have time, I join.
questions.explanation: The pattern if + simple past, would + base verb expresses an unreal or unlikely present situation.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to 'ELUSIVE'.
questions.explanation: ELUSIVE describes something difficult to find, catch, or define.

questions.question: Which sentence avoids a double negative?
choices: She didn't see anyone at the gate.
He never said nothing about it.
questions.explanation: Anyone is correctly used with the negative didn't.

questions.question: Choose the correct comparative form.
choices: This route is safest than the other.
This route is safer than the other.
This route is most safe than the other.
questions.explanation: SAFER is the comparative form of the one-syllable adjective safe.

questions.question: Which sentence uses a colon correctly?
choices: Bring: your ID, application form, and receipt.
Bring the following items: your ID, application form, and receipt.
Bring the following: items your ID, application form, and receipt.
Bring the following items your ID: application form, and receipt.
questions.explanation: A colon can introduce a list after a complete introductory clause.

questions.question: Choose the correct pronoun: 'Every applicant must bring ______ own identification.'
questions.explanation: Singular THEY is widely accepted as a gender-neutral pronoun referring to every applicant.

questions.question: Choose the antonym of 'RELUCTANT'.
questions.explanation: RELUCTANT means unwilling or hesitant; EAGER means enthusiastic or willing.

questions.question: Which sentence is correctly written in reported speech? Direct: Ana said, 'I am busy.'
choices: Ana said that I am busy.
Ana said that she was busy.
Ana says that she were busy.
Ana said she is being busy yesterday.
questions.explanation: In standard backshifted reported speech, am becomes was and I refers to Ana as she.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to 'SCRUTINIZE'.
questions.explanation: SCRUTINIZE means to inspect or examine carefully.

questions.question: All managers are leaders. Some leaders are visionaries. Which conclusion must be true?
questions.explanation: From 'All managers are leaders' and 'Some leaders are visionaries,' we can only conclude that some managers may be visionaries.

questions.question: If PLANT is coded as QMBOU, how is WATER coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 1: W→X, A→B, T→U, E→F, R→S. So WATER = XBUFS.

questions.question: Maria is taller than Ana. Ana is taller than Beth. Who is the shortest?
questions.explanation: Maria > Ana > Beth. Therefore, Beth is the shortest.

questions.question: What comes next in the series: A, C, E, G, ___?
questions.explanation: The series skips every other letter: A, C, E, G, I. The next letter is I.

questions.question: Doctor is to Patient as Teacher is to ___?
questions.explanation: A Doctor serves a Patient; a Teacher serves a Student. The relationship is between a professional and the person they serve.

questions.question: If some roses are red and all red things are beautiful, which conclusion is valid?
questions.explanation: Since SOME roses are red, and all red things are beautiful, only SOME roses are beautiful — not all.

questions.question: In a row of 10 students, Lena is 4th from the left. What is her position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = (Total + 1) - Position from left = (10 + 1) - 4 = 7.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Triangle, Square, Cone, Pentagon
questions.explanation: Triangle, Square, and Pentagon are 2D shapes. Cone is a 3D solid — the odd one out.

questions.question: What number should replace the question mark? 2, 4, 8, 16, ?
questions.explanation: Each number is doubled: 2×2=4, 4×2=8, 8×2=16, 16×2=32.

questions.question: Eye is to See as Ear is to ___?
questions.explanation: An Eye is used to See; an Ear is used to Hear. The relationship is between a sensory organ and its function.

questions.question: If today is Wednesday, what day will it be 100 days from now?
questions.explanation: 100 ÷ 7 = 14 weeks remainder 2. Wednesday + 2 days = Friday.

questions.question: Which conclusion follows from: 'No fish are mammals. All whales are mammals.'?
questions.explanation: Since all whales are mammals and no fish are mammals, no whales are fish.

questions.question: A clock shows 3:00. What is the angle between the hour and minute hands?
questions.explanation: At 3:00, each hour mark is 30°, so the angle = 3 × 30° = 90°.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Apple, Mango, Carrot, Banana
questions.explanation: Apple, Mango, and Banana are fruits. Carrot is a vegetable — the odd one out.

questions.question: If RED = 27 (R=18, E=5, D=4), what is the value of CAT?
Five friends sit in a row from left to right. Ana is at the left end and Eva is at the right end. Beth sits between Ana and Carlos, and David sits next to Eva. Who sits in the middle?
questions.explanation: The order is Ana, Beth, Carlos, David, Eva. Carlos is in the middle.

questions.question: Complete the analogy: Book is to Library as Painting is to ___?
questions.explanation: Books are displayed in a Library; Paintings are displayed in a Museum.

questions.question: What is the next number: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ___?
questions.explanation: This is the Fibonacci sequence: each number is the sum of the two before it. 5+8=13.

questions.question: A is the mother of B. B is the sister of C. C is the father of D. What is A to D?
questions.explanation: A is the mother of B and C (siblings). C is the father of D. So A is the grandmother of D.

questions.question: Which shape has the most sides: Pentagon, Hexagon, Octagon, Heptagon?
questions.explanation: Pentagon=5, Hexagon=6, Heptagon=7, Octagon=8 sides. Octagon has the most.

questions.question: All birds have wings. A penguin is a bird. Therefore:
choices: A penguin is not a bird.
questions.explanation: Deductively: All birds have wings + A penguin is a bird → A penguin has wings. Flying is not mentioned.

questions.question: What comes next? ZA, YB, XC, WD, ___
questions.explanation: First letter goes backward (Z,Y,X,W,V) and second letter goes forward (A,B,C,D,E). Next is VE.

questions.question: Three houses stand in a row. The red house is to the left of the green house. The blue house is to the right of the green house. Which house is in the middle?
questions.explanation: The order is Red, Green, Blue. Green is in the middle.

questions.question: If CLOCK = 43, where each letter's value equals its position (C=3, L=12, O=15, C=3, K=11), what is the sum for ACE?
A is older than B. C is younger than A but older than B. D is older than A. Who is the youngest?
questions.explanation: Order from oldest: D > A > C > B. B is the youngest.

questions.question: What number is missing? 4, 9, 16, 25, ___, 49
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares: 2²=4, 3²=9, 4²=16, 5²=25, 6²=36, 7²=49. The missing number is 36.

questions.question: If all Zips are Zaps, and no Zaps are Zops, which is definitely true?
questions.explanation: All Zips are Zaps, and no Zaps are Zops — therefore no Zips can be Zops.

questions.question: A man points to a woman and says, 'Her mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: The only daughter of the man's mother is his sister. Since the woman's mother is his sister, the woman is his niece.

questions.question: Choose the figure that completes the pattern: Circle, Square, Triangle, Circle, Square, ___
questions.explanation: The pattern repeats: Circle, Square, Triangle. The next in sequence after Circle, Square is Triangle.

questions.question: In a code where 1=A, 2=B, 3=C... what does 2-9-7 spell?
questions.explanation: Using 1=A, 2=B, 3=C, and so on: 2=B, 9=I, 7=G. The code spells BIG.

questions.question: All diamonds are precious stones. Some precious stones are rare. Which conclusion must be true?
questions.explanation: Because diamonds belong to the larger category of precious stones, and some precious stones are rare, diamonds *may* intersect with rare stones, but it's not guaranteed for all.

questions.question: If BREAD is coded as CSFBE, how is TOAST coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter shifts forward by 1 in the alphabet: T→U, O→P, A→B, S→T, T→U. Thus, TOAST becomes UPBTU.

questions.question: David is faster than Kevin. Kevin is slower than Leo but faster than Mark. Who is the slowest?
questions.explanation: From the text, David > Kevin, Leo > Kevin, and Kevin > Mark. This places Mark definitively at the bottom of the speed order.

questions.question: What completes the series: B2, D4, F6, H8, ___?
questions.explanation: The letters advance by skipping one (B, D, F, H, J) and the numbers match the alphabet position of the letters (J is the 10th letter).

questions.question: Glove is to Hand as Shoe is to ___?
questions.explanation: A glove directly covers and fits a hand; a shoe directly covers and fits a foot.

questions.question: If no triangles are squares and all squares are quadrilaterals, which statement must be true?
questions.explanation: Since all squares are quadrilaterals, and none of those squares can be triangles, the quadrilaterals that are squares are definitely not triangles.

questions.question: In a queue of 15 people, Sam is 6th from the front. What is his position from the back?
questions.explanation: Position from back = (Total count + 1) - Position from front. (15 + 1) - 6 = 10th.

questions.question: What number replaces the question mark? 3, 9, 27, 81, ?
questions.explanation: Each successive term is multiplied by 3: 81 × 3 = 243.

questions.question: Compass is to Direction as Thermometer is to ___?
questions.explanation: A compass is an instrument used specifically to measure or indicate direction; a thermometer is an instrument used to measure temperature.

questions.question: If yesterday was Tuesday, what day of the week will it be 50 days from today?
questions.explanation: If yesterday was Tuesday, today is Wednesday. 50 divided by 7 equals 7 weeks with a remainder of 1 day. Wednesday + 1 day = Thursday.

questions.question: Given: All employees must pass the exam. John did not pass the exam. What is the logical conclusion?
choices: John might be allowed to retake it.
questions.explanation: By contraposition: If being an employee requires passing, and John did not pass, John logically cannot be an employee.

questions.question: At exactly 6:00, what is the angle measurement between the clock hands?
questions.explanation: At 6:00, the hour hand points directly at 6 and the minute hand points at 12, creating a straight line which measures 180°.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: Whale, Shark, Dolphin, Seal
questions.explanation: Whales, dolphins, and seals are marine mammals. A shark is a cartilaginous fish.

questions.question: If CODE = 24 using a basic alpha sum (C=3, O=15, D=4, E=5), what is the total value of TASK?

Five cars are parked side by side. The white car is at the far right. The silver car is immediately left of the white car. The red car is immediately left of the silver car. The blue car is immediately left of the red car. A green car is at the far left. Which car is in the middle position?
questions.explanation: The order is Green, Blue, Red, Silver, White. Red is third, the middle car.

questions.question: Complete the analogy: Canvas is to Painter as Wood is to ___?
questions.explanation: A canvas is the primary raw material transformed by a painter; wood is the primary raw material transformed by a carpenter.

questions.question: What is the next number in this sequence: 2, 5, 11, 23, ___?
questions.explanation: The pattern follows the rule (Previous Number × 2) + 1. Therefore: (23 × 2) + 1 = 47.

questions.question: A woman introduces a man as 'the son of the only brother of my mother'. How is the man related to the woman?
questions.explanation: The mother's only brother is the woman's uncle. The son of her uncle is her cousin.

questions.question: Which geometric shape contains the fewest internal diagonals: Rectangle, Pentagon, Triangle, Hexagon?
questions.explanation: A triangle contains 0 diagonals. A rectangle has 2, a pentagon has 5, and a hexagon has 9.

questions.question: What number comes next? 3, 8, 15, 24, 35, __
questions.explanation: The differences are 5, 7, 9, 11; the next difference is 13, so 35 + 13 = 48.

questions.question: All clerks are employees. Some employees are accountants. Which conclusion must be true?
questions.explanation: The first statement directly establishes that every clerk is an employee.

questions.question: If MONDAY is coded as NPOEBZ by shifting each letter one step forward, how is FRIDAY coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter moves one place forward: F-G, R-S, I-J, D-E, A-B, Y-Z.

questions.question: Four people sit in a row. L is left of M; N is right of M; O is left of L. Who is second from the left?
questions.explanation: The order is O, L, M, N; L is second.

questions.question: If 5 machines make 5 items in 5 minutes, how long will 100 machines take to make 100 items at the same rate?
questions.explanation: Each machine makes one item in five minutes, so 100 machines make 100 items in five minutes.

questions.question: A is the sister of B. B is the father of C. How is A related to C?
questions.explanation: A is the sister of C's father, so A is C's aunt.

questions.question: Complete the analogy: Book is to reading as fork is to ____.
questions.explanation: A book is used for reading; a fork is used for eating.

questions.question: If today is Wednesday, what day will it be 45 days from today?
questions.explanation: 45 days is 6 weeks and 3 days; three days after Wednesday is Saturday.

questions.question: In a group of 40, 25 like tea, 20 like coffee, and 10 like both. How many like neither?
questions.explanation: At least one = 25 + 20 - 10 = 35. Neither = 40 - 35 = 5.

questions.question: Which pair has the same relationship as Seed : Plant?
questions.explanation: A seed can develop into a plant, just as an egg can develop into a bird.

questions.question: If the first and last letters of the word GARDEN are exchanged, what is the resulting word?
questions.explanation: Exchanging G and N gives NARD E G, or NARDEG.

questions.question: A is older than B. C is younger than B. D is older than A. Who is oldest?
questions.explanation: D is older than A, who is older than B, who is older than C.

questions.question: If all roses are flowers and no flowers are made of metal, which statement follows?
choices: No roses are made of metal.
questions.explanation: Since roses are flowers and no flowers are metal, roses cannot be metal.

questions.question: A person walks 4 km north, then 3 km east. In which direction is the person from the starting point?
questions.explanation: The person is north and east of the starting point, hence northeast.

questions.question: Choose the item that does not belong.
questions.explanation: January, March, and May have 31 days; June has 30.

questions.question: If 12 workers finish a job in 10 days, how many days would 6 workers need at the same rate?
questions.explanation: Half as many workers require twice the time: 10 × 2 = 20 days.

questions.question: In a code, 4 means +, 5 means −, 6 means ×. What is 8 6 2 4 3?
questions.explanation: Replace the symbols: 8 × 2 + 3 = 19, using multiplication before addition.

questions.question: Which number is different from the others?
questions.explanation: 16, 25, and 36 are perfect squares; 48 is not.

questions.question: A class has 18 boys and 12 girls. What fraction of the class are girls?
questions.explanation: There are 30 students; 12/30 simplifies to 2/5.

questions.question: If PENCIL is arranged alphabetically by its letters, which letter is third?
questions.explanation: Alphabetical order is C, E, I, L, N, P; the third letter is I.

questions.question: Five books are stacked. Red is above Blue. Green is below Blue. Yellow is above Red. Which book is highest among these four?
questions.explanation: Yellow is above Red, which is above Blue, which is above Green.

questions.question: If some doctors are writers and all writers are readers, which conclusion follows?
questions.explanation: The doctors who are writers must also be readers.

questions.question: A number is doubled and then increased by 7 to get 31. What is the number?
questions.explanation: Let x be the number: 2x + 7 = 31, so x = 12.

questions.question: Which comes next in the sequence of shapes: triangle, square, pentagon, hexagon, __?
questions.explanation: The number of sides increases from 3 to 4, 5, and 6; next is 7, a heptagon.

questions.question: Rina is 7th from the front and 9th from the back of a line. How many people are in the line?
questions.explanation: Total = 7 + 9 - 1 = 15 because Rina is counted from both ends.

questions.question: What is 15% of 240?
A train travels 360 km in 4 hours. What is its speed in km/h?
questions.explanation: Speed = Distance ÷ Time = 360 ÷ 4 = 90 km/h

questions.question: If 3x + 7 = 22, what is the value of x?
What is the next number in the series: 2, 6, 18, 54, ___?
questions.explanation: Each number is multiplied by 3: 54×3=162

questions.question: A rectangle has a length of 12 cm and a width of 8 cm. What is its area?
questions.explanation: Area = length × width = 12 × 8 = 96 sq cm

questions.question: If a shirt costs ₱850 after a 15% discount, what was the original price?
questions.explanation: ₱850 = 85% of original price. Original = 850 ÷ 0.85 = ₱1,000

questions.question: What is the average of 45, 62, 78, 55, and 70?
A worker can finish a job in 6 days. Another can finish it in 4 days. How long working together?
questions.explanation: Combined rate = 1/6 + 1/4 = 5/12 per day. Time = 12/5 = 2.4 days

questions.question: What is the square root of 1,764?
If the ratio of boys to girls in a class is 3:5 and there are 24 boys, how many girls are there?
questions.explanation: 3 parts = 24, so 1 part = 8. Girls = 5 × 8 = 40

questions.question: What is the next number in the series: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ___?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares: 6²=36

questions.question: A store marks up a product by 40% from its cost of ₱500. What is the selling price?
questions.explanation: Markup = 40% of ₱500 = ₱200. Selling price = ₱500 + ₱200 = ₱700

questions.question: If 5 pens cost ₱75, how much do 12 pens cost?
What is 20% of 20% of 500?
The perimeter of a square is 64 cm. What is its area?
questions.explanation: Side = 64 ÷ 4 = 16 cm. Area = 16 × 16 = 256 sq cm.

questions.question: A car travels at 60 km/h for 2.5 hours. How far does it travel?
questions.explanation: Distance = Speed × Time = 60 × 2.5 = 150 km

questions.question: What is the missing number: 7, 14, __, 28, 35?
questions.explanation: Multiples of 7: 7, 14, 21, 28, 35. Missing = 21.

questions.question: Ana is 3 times older than Ben. If Ben is 8 years old, how old is Ana?
questions.explanation: Ana = 3 × 8 = 24 years old.

questions.question: What is the value of 2³ + 3²?
A pipe fills a tank in 3 hours, another drains it in 6 hours. How long to fill with both open?
questions.explanation: Net rate = 1/3 - 1/6 = 1/6 per hour. Time = 6 hours.

questions.question: What is 35% of 400?
A number increased by 25% gives 250. What is the original number?
What is the least common multiple (LCM) of 6 and 8?
questions.explanation: LCM of 6 and 8 = 24.

questions.question: If a shirt originally costs ₱1,200 and is on sale for ₱960, what is the discount percentage?
questions.explanation: Discount = ₱240. Percentage = (240 ÷ 1200) × 100 = 20%

questions.question: A class has 40 students. If 60% are female, how many are male?
questions.explanation: Female = 24. Male = 40 - 24 = 16.

questions.question: What is the next term: 3, 7, 13, 21, 31, ___?
If 2x - 5 = 11, what is x?
A triangle has a base of 10 cm and height of 6 cm. What is its area?
questions.explanation: Area = ½ × 10 × 6 = 30 sq cm

questions.question: What is the greatest common factor (GCF) of 36 and 48?
questions.explanation: GCF of 36 and 48 = 12.

questions.question: A salesman earns 5% commission. If he sold ₱80,000 worth, how much commission?
What is 22% of 450?
A runner covers 15 kilometers in 1.5 hours. What is their average speed in km/h?
questions.explanation: Speed = Distance ÷ Time = 15 ÷ 1.5 = 10 km/h.

questions.question: Solve for x if 5x - 12 = 18.
Identify the next number in the series: 3, 12, 48, 192, ___?
questions.explanation: Each number is multiplied by 4: 192 × 4 = 768.

questions.question: A square property has a side length of 15 meters. What is its total area?
questions.explanation: Area of a square = side² = 15 × 15 = 225 sq m.

questions.question: An item sells for ₱1,200 after a 20% discount. What was the item's original retail price?
questions.explanation: ₱1,200 represents 80% of the original cost. Original Price = 1,200 ÷ 0.80 = ₱1,500.

questions.question: What is the statistical mean (average) of 12, 18, 25, 31, and 34?
Machine A can finish a data batch processing job in 8 hours, while Machine B can complete it in 8 hours. Working concurrently, how long will they take?
questions.explanation: Combined rate = 1/8 + 1/8 = 2/8 = 1/4 batch per hour. Total time required = 4 hours.

questions.question: What is the square root value of 2,916?
questions.explanation: 54 × 54 = 2,916, making 54 its square root.

questions.question: The ratio of concrete to sand in a mix is 2:7. If there are 14 bags of concrete, how many bags of sand are needed?
questions.explanation: 2 parts = 14 bags, meaning 1 part = 7 bags. Sand requirement = 7 parts × 7 = 49 bags.

questions.question: Find the missing term in the sequence: 4, 12, 20, ___, 36.
questions.explanation: The series increases by a fixed addition of 8 each step. 20 + 8 = 28.

questions.question: A wholesale warehouse marks up an item by 30% over its production cost of ₱350. What is its final selling price?
questions.explanation: Markup value = 30% of ₱350 = ₱105. Selling Price = 350 + 105 = ₱455.

questions.question: If 8 pieces of corporate token items cost ₱600, what is the cost for 15 pieces?
questions.explanation: Unit price = 600 ÷ 8 = ₱75. Cost for 15 items = 15 × 75 = ₱1,125.

questions.question: Evaluate: 25% of 40% of 800.
questions.explanation: 40% of 800 = 320. Next, 25% (one quarter) of 320 = 80.

questions.question: A square field has a total perimeter boundary of 120 meters. Calculate its internal area.
questions.explanation: Side measurement = 120 ÷ 4 = 30 meters. Total Area = 30 × 30 = 900 sq m.

questions.question: A delivery vehicle drives at 70 km/h for 3.5 hours. What total distance does it cover?
questions.explanation: Distance = Speed × Time duration = 70 × 3.5 = 245 kilometers.

questions.question: Evaluate the arithmetic operation expression: 4³ - 5².
questions.explanation: 4³ = 64 and 5² = 25. Evaluating 64 - 25 yields 39.

questions.question: An open input pipe fills a water container in 4 hours, whereas an escape valve empties it in 12 hours. If both run, how long to fill the container?
questions.explanation: Net rate per hour = 1/4 - 1/12 = 3/12 - 1/12 = 2/12 = 1/6. Total time required = 6 hours.

questions.question: Find the Least Common Multiple (LCM) value for the numbers 9 and 12.
questions.explanation: Multiples of 9: 9, 18, 27, 36. Multiples of 12: 12, 24, 36. The smallest shared multiple is 36.

questions.question: A production department employs 60 staff members. If 35% are assigned to field shifts, how many work inside the office?
questions.explanation: Office percentage = 100% - 35% = 65%. Office staff count = 0.65 × 60 = 39 workers.

questions.question: What is 18% of 450?
Simplify: 3/4 + 2/3.
questions.explanation: Using denominator 12: 9/12 + 8/12 = 17/12.

questions.question: A bag costs ₱1,250 after a 20% discount. What was its original price?
Find the average of 12, 15, 18, 21, and 24.
questions.explanation: Their sum is 90; 90 ÷ 5 = 18.

questions.question: A vehicle travels 150 km in 3 hours. What is its average speed?
questions.explanation: Average speed = distance ÷ time = 150 ÷ 3 = 50 km/h.

questions.question: Solve for x: 5x − 7 = 28.
questions.explanation: Add 7 to both sides: 5x = 35; divide by 5 to get x = 7.

questions.question: What is the simple interest on ₱8,000 at 5% per year for 3 years?
A rectangle has a length of 14 cm and a width of 9 cm. What is its perimeter?
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2(14 + 9) = 46 cm.

questions.question: What is the least common multiple of 8 and 12?
questions.explanation: The smallest number divisible by both 8 and 12 is 24.

questions.question: A ratio of 3:5 has a total of 64. What is the larger share?
questions.explanation: There are 8 total parts; each is 64 ÷ 8 = 8. Larger share = 5 × 8 = 40.

questions.question: Convert 2.75 hours to minutes.
What is the square root of 900?
questions.explanation: 30 × 30 = 900, so the square root is 30.

questions.question: A tank is 3/5 full. If its capacity is 250 liters, how much water is in it?
If 7 notebooks cost ₱196, how much do 5 notebooks cost at the same price per notebook?
questions.explanation: Each notebook costs 196 ÷ 7 = ₱28; 5 cost ₱140.

questions.question: Evaluate: 4² + 3 × 5.
questions.explanation: Apply order of operations: 16 + 15 = 31.

questions.question: A number decreased by 15% becomes 170. What was the original number?
questions.explanation: 170 is 85% of the original; 170 ÷ 0.85 = 200.

questions.question: Find the area of a triangle with base 12 cm and height 7 cm.
questions.explanation: Area = 1/2 × base × height = 1/2 × 12 × 7 = 42 cm².

questions.question: What is the median of 4, 9, 2, 11, 7, 5, and 13?
questions.explanation: Ordered values are 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13; the middle value is 7.

questions.question: A worker earns ₱640 for 8 hours. At the same hourly rate, how much will the worker earn for 6 hours?
questions.explanation: Hourly rate = 640 ÷ 8 = ₱80; 6 hours = ₱480.

questions.question: Express 0.375 as a fraction in simplest form.
questions.explanation: 0.375 = 375/1000, which simplifies to 3/8.

questions.question: A store marks up an item costing ₱400 by 25%. What is the selling price?
questions.explanation: 25% of ₱400 is ₱100; selling price is ₱500.

questions.question: If x/6 = 7/3, what is x?
questions.explanation: Multiply both sides by 6: x = 6 × 7/3 = 14.

questions.question: A circle has a radius of 7 cm. Using π = 22/7, what is its circumference?
questions.explanation: Circumference = 2πr = 2 × 22/7 × 7 = 44 cm.

questions.question: A class has 36 students. If 1/4 are absent, how many are present?
questions.explanation: One-fourth of 36 is 9 absent; 36 − 9 = 27 present.

questions.question: What is 2.4 × 0.5?
questions.explanation: Multiplying by 0.5 is taking half; half of 2.4 is 1.2.

questions.question: A bus has 48 seats. If 7/8 are occupied, how many seats are occupied?
A ₱2,400 appliance is paid in 6 equal monthly installments with no interest. How much is each installment?
If 3 pens and 2 pencils cost ₱46, and each pen costs ₱10, how much do the 2 pencils cost?
questions.explanation: Three pens cost ₱30; ₱46 − ₱30 = ₱16 for two pencils.

questions.question: A number is 40% of 250. What is the number?
What are the three branches of the Philippine government?
questions.explanation: The three branches are the Executive (President), Legislative (Congress), and Judicial (Supreme Court), under the doctrine of separation of powers.

questions.question: Which branch of the Philippine government has the power to declare a law unconstitutional?
questions.explanation: The Judicial branch, particularly the Supreme Court, has the power of judicial review.

questions.question: The Civil Service Commission is a ____________ body.
questions.explanation: The Civil Service Commission (CSC) is a constitutional body under Article IX of the 1987 Constitution.

questions.question: What is the national flower of the Philippines?
questions.explanation: The Sampaguita (Jasminum sambac) was declared the national flower in 1934.

questions.question: Which Philippine law mandates the Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials?
questions.explanation: RA 6713 is the Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees, enacted in 1989.

questions.question: How many senators are there in the Philippine Senate?
questions.explanation: The Philippine Senate is composed of 24 senators who serve 6-year terms.

questions.question: What is the national hero of the Philippines?
questions.explanation: Dr. Jose Rizal is the officially declared national hero, recognized through the Rizal Law (RA 1425).

questions.question: What is the capital city of the Philippines?
questions.explanation: Manila is the official capital city and seat of government of the Philippines.

questions.question: What is the term of office of the President of the Philippines?
questions.explanation: Under the 1987 Constitution, the President serves a single 6-year term and is not eligible for reelection.

questions.question: What does RA 3019 penalize?
choices: Graft and corrupt practices by public officers
Failure to file income tax returns
questions.explanation: RA 3019 is the Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act, penalizing corrupt practices by public officers.

questions.question: Under RA 6713, public officials must file the SALN within how many days of assumption of office?
questions.explanation: Under RA 6713, the SALN must be filed within 30 days after assuming office.

questions.question: Which government body administers the Civil Service Examination in the Philippines?
questions.explanation: The Civil Service Commission (CSC) administers the Civil Service Examination.

questions.question: The principle that no person shall be tried twice for the same offense is known as:
questions.explanation: Double jeopardy is the constitutional principle in Article III of the 1987 Constitution.

questions.question: Under civil service rules, what is the maximum period for preventive suspension?
questions.explanation: Under the Revised Rules on Administrative Cases in the Civil Service (RRACCS), maximum preventive suspension is 90 days.

questions.question: What is the minimum passing score for the Civil Service Exam (Professional Level)?
questions.explanation: The minimum passing score for the Civil Service Examination (Professional Level) is 80 out of 100.

questions.question: What does 'plunder' mean under Philippine law (RA 7080)?
choices: Any act of corruption regardless of amount
Amassing ill-gotten wealth of at least ₱50 million through a series of acts
Failure to declare assets in the SALN
questions.explanation: Under RA 7080, plunder is amassing ill-gotten wealth of at least ₱50 million through a combination of overt criminal acts.

questions.question: Under the principle of public accountability, public office is a:
questions.explanation: Article XI, Section 1 of the 1987 Constitution: 'Public office is a public trust.'

questions.question: The mandatory retirement age for government employees in the Philippines is:
questions.explanation: Under RA 8291 and civil service rules, the mandatory retirement age is 65 years old.

questions.question: What is the highest peak in the Philippines?
questions.explanation: Mt. Apo in Davao del Sur is the highest mountain in the Philippines at 2,954 meters.

questions.question: Who was the first President of the Philippine Commonwealth?
questions.explanation: Manuel L. Quezon was the first President of the Philippine Commonwealth, serving from 1935.

questions.question: What does EDSA stand for?
questions.explanation: EDSA stands for Epifanio Delos Santos Avenue, site of the 1986 People Power Revolution.

questions.question: Which Philippine law is known as the Anti-Red Tape Act?
questions.explanation: RA 9485 is the Anti-Red Tape Act (ARTA), which aims to improve government frontline service delivery.

questions.question: A government employee absent without approved leave (AWOL) for how many days may be dropped from the rolls?
questions.explanation: Under CSC rules, a government employee AWOL for 30 or more consecutive working days may be dropped from the rolls.

questions.question: Which of the following is considered Grave Misconduct for a government employee?
questions.explanation: Accepting bribes is Grave Misconduct, punishable by dismissal under civil service rules.

questions.question: The Ombudsman of the Philippines is empowered to investigate complaints against:
questions.explanation: The Office of the Ombudsman has jurisdiction over public officials and employees, including those in GOCCs.

questions.question: What does the Bill of Rights protect?
choices: The rights of the government against citizens
The fundamental rights of citizens against government action
Only the rights of elected officials
questions.explanation: The Bill of Rights (Article III, 1987 Constitution) protects the fundamental rights of citizens against abuses of government power.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a constitutional commission?
questions.explanation: The Commission on Human Rights is a constitutional body but NOT a constitutional commission. The three constitutional commissions are CSC, COMELEC, and COA.

questions.question: The right to a speedy, impartial, and public trial is guaranteed under which article of the 1987 Constitution?
questions.explanation: Article III (Bill of Rights) of the 1987 Constitution guarantees the right to a speedy, impartial, and public trial.

questions.question: What principle requires government decisions to be based on ability and qualifications, not personal connections?
questions.explanation: Meritocracy is the principle that positions should be based on ability and performance, not on favoritism.

questions.question: How many members does the House of Representatives have at most under the 1987 Constitution?
questions.explanation: Under the 1987 Constitution, the House of Representatives shall have not more than 250 members unless otherwise fixed by law.

questions.question: Which environmental law in the Philippines is known as the Clean Air Act?
questions.explanation: RA 8749 is the Philippine Clean Air Act of 1999, which aims to achieve and maintain clean air for all Filipinos.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act (RA 10121)?
choices: To provide financial aid only after disasters
To strengthen the country's disaster risk reduction and management system
To establish disaster insurance for all Filipinos
To create a new government department for disasters
questions.explanation: RA 10121 (NDRRMA) strengthens the disaster risk reduction and management system of the Philippines, focusing on prevention, mitigation, preparedness, and response.

questions.question: The Philippine Clean Water Act (RA 9275) primarily aims to:
choices: Protect the country's water bodies from pollution
Provide clean drinking water to all provinces
questions.explanation: RA 9275 protects the country's water bodies from land-based sources of pollution.

questions.question: Which of the following is a key principle of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights?
choices: All human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights
Rights may be suspended during wartime
Rights are granted by the government
questions.explanation: Article 1 of the UDHR states: 'All human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights.'

questions.question: What is the official currency of the Philippines?
questions.explanation: The official currency is the Philippine Peso (₱), issued by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP).

questions.question: The Philippine Ecological Solid Waste Management Act (RA 9003) promotes:
choices: Burning of waste in designated areas
Segregation and recycling of waste at the source
questions.explanation: RA 9003 promotes systematic and comprehensive waste management including waste segregation, collection, and recycling.

questions.question: What does the phrase 'separation of Church and State' mean in the Philippine context?
choices: Religion is banned in public spaces
The government cannot interfere with religious affairs, and vice versa
Only Christians can hold public office
questions.explanation: Article II, Section 6 of the 1987 Constitution provides for the separation of Church and State, meaning neither can interfere with the affairs of the other.

questions.question: The Philippines was declared a republic on:
questions.explanation: On July 4, 1946, the Philippines gained independence from the United States, becoming a fully independent republic.

questions.question: The 'Noli Me Tangere' was written by Dr. Jose Rizal in which language?
questions.explanation: 'Noli Me Tangere' was written in Spanish (Español) and published in 1887 in Berlin, Germany.

questions.question: The Katipunan was founded in:
questions.explanation: The Katipunan was founded by Andres Bonifacio on July 7, 1892 in Tondo, Manila.

questions.question: The Philippines has how many regions?
questions.explanation: The Philippines has 17 regions, including the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM).

questions.question: Under RA 6713, which of the following is NOT a norm of conduct for public officials?
questions.explanation: RA 6713 prohibits using public office for personal enrichment. Accumulation of wealth is contrary to its norms.

questions.question: Who was the President of the Philippines when the 1987 Constitution was ratified?
questions.explanation: Corazon 'Cory' Aquino was President when the 1987 Constitution was ratified, after the restoration of democracy.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the SALN?
choices: To disclose a public official's assets and liabilities for transparency
To apply for a government loan
To declare candidacy for public office
questions.explanation: The SALN (Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth) promotes transparency and accountability among public officials.

questions.question: The 'El Filibusterismo' was written by:
questions.explanation: 'El Filibusterismo' was written by Jose Rizal and published in 1891 in Ghent, Belgium.

questions.question: Which constitutional article covers the Legislative Department?
questions.explanation: Article VI of the 1987 Constitution covers the Legislative Department (Congress).

questions.question: Andres Bonifacio is known as:
questions.explanation: Andres Bonifacio is recognized as the Father of the Philippine Revolution for founding the Katipunan in 1892.

questions.question: Which law established the K to 12 Basic Education Program?
questions.explanation: RA 10533 or the Enhanced Basic Education Act of 2013 established the K to 12 Program.

questions.question: What does the term 'habeas corpus' refer to?
choices: A writ requiring a person to be brought before a court to determine lawfulness of detention
A court order to pay damages
questions.explanation: Habeas corpus is a legal writ that requires a person under arrest to be brought before a judge to examine whether detention is lawful.

questions.question: The COMELEC is responsible for:
questions.explanation: The Commission on Elections (COMELEC) is constitutionally mandated to administer and enforce election laws and regulations.

questions.question: According to the 1987 Philippine Constitution, what is the minimum age requirement to run for a seat in the Senate?
questions.explanation: Article VI, Section 3 of the 1987 Constitution mandates that a candidate for the Senate must be at least 35 years of age on the day of the election.

questions.question: Which of the following bodies has the sole power to try and decide all cases of impeachment under Philippine law?
questions.explanation: Under Article XI of the 1987 Constitution, the House of Representatives has the exclusive power to initiate impeachment, but the Senate has the sole power to try and decide all impeachment cases.

questions.question: What is the maximum number of consecutive terms an elected member of the House of Representatives can serve?
questions.explanation: Members of the House of Representatives are elected to a 3-year term and are limited to serving a maximum of three consecutive terms.

questions.question: Under RA 6713, within what period must a government official or employee respond to letters, telegrams, or other communication sent by the public?
questions.explanation: RA 6713 mandates that all public officials and employees must respond to letters or communications from the public within 15 working days from receipt thereof.

questions.question: Which specialized constitutional court has jurisdiction over criminal and civil cases involving graft and corrupt practices committed by public officers?
questions.explanation: The Sandiganbayan is the anti-graft court of the Philippines, constitutionally mandated to handle cases involving corruption and misconduct by public officials.

questions.question: What type of vote is required in Congress to override a presidential veto of a bill?
choices: Simple majority of both houses voting separately
Two-thirds vote of all the members of each house voting separately
Three-fourths vote of both houses in a joint session
Unanimous vote of the main authors
questions.explanation: According to Article VI, Section 27 of the Constitution, if the President vetoes a bill, Congress can override it by a two-thirds vote of all members of each house voting separately.

questions.question: The power of the state to take private property for public use upon payment of just compensation is known as:
questions.explanation: Eminent domain is the constitutional power of the government to acquire private property for public utility, provided the owner is paid just compensation.

questions.question: Who is the ex-officio Commander-in-Chief of all armed forces of the Philippines?
choices: The Chief of Staff of the AFP
questions.explanation: Article VII, Section 18 states that the President shall be the Commander-in-Chief of all armed forces of the Philippines.

questions.question: Which of the following is an essential requirement for a bill to officially become a law in the Philippines?
choices: It must be signed by the Chief Justice.
It must undergo three readings on separate days in both houses.
It must be approved by a national referendum.
It must be reviewed by the Civil Service Commission.
questions.explanation: Except when the President certifies a bill as urgent to meet a public calamity or emergency, no bill can become law unless it passes three readings on separate days in both houses.

questions.question: What environmental law mandates the establishment of an environmental impact statement system to assess projects that affect nature?
questions.explanation: Presidential Decree No. 1586 established the Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) System to ensure environmental protection amid economic and infrastructure development.

questions.question: Under the 1987 Constitution, how long may martial law or the suspension of the privilege of the writ of habeas corpus last, unless extended by Congress?
questions.explanation: The Constitution limits the proclamation of martial law or suspension of the writ of habeas corpus to a maximum period of 60 days, requiring congressional review for any extension.

questions.question: Which basic right ensures that no person is held to answer for a criminal offense without a formal step-by-step lawful legal proceeding?
choices: Right to Due Process of Law
questions.explanation: Article III, Section 1 states that no person shall be deprived of life, liberty, or property without due process of law.

questions.question: Which government body has the authority to audit, examine, and settle all accounts pertaining to the revenue and expenditures of government agencies?
questions.explanation: The Commission on Audit (COA) is the independent constitutional commission tasked with auditing all government financial records and property usage.

questions.question: Which norm of conduct under RA 6713 requires public officials to lead modest lives and avoid ostentation?
questions.explanation: 'Simple Living' is an explicit norm under RA 6713 requiring public officials to lead modest lives and avoid showy displays of wealth.

questions.question: What landmark Philippine law provides a comprehensive policy to promote the rights and welfare of women and eliminate discrimination against them?
questions.explanation: RA 9710 is the Magna Carta of Women, which provides a comprehensive framework for protecting and promoting women's rights in the Philippines.

questions.question: The systematic optimization or streamlining of government procedures to eliminate excessive bureaucratic delays is managed by which law?
questions.explanation: RA 11032 is the Ease of Doing Business and Efficient Government Service Delivery Act, which amended the older Anti-Red Tape Act (RA 9485).

questions.question: Which basic freedom protects a citizen from being forced to testify against themselves in a criminal investigation or court trial?
questions.explanation: The right against self-incrimination is guaranteed by the Constitution under the Bill of Rights, stating that no person shall be compelled to be a witness against himself.

questions.question: How long is the official term of office for standard elected local government officials like Governors and Mayors in a single term cycle?
questions.explanation: Under the Local Government Code and the Constitution, local officials serve for a term of 3 years and can be re-elected for up to three consecutive terms.

questions.question: What is the primary language used by Dr. Jose Rizal to write his famous political essay 'The Philippines a Century Hence'?
questions.explanation: Rizal wrote his critical historical and socio-political essays, including 'Filipinas dentro de un siglo' (The Philippines a Century Hence), in Spanish.

questions.question: Which branch of the Philippine government interprets laws?
questions.explanation: The Judiciary interprets laws and resolves justiciable controversies.

questions.question: What is the minimum voting age for Filipino citizens under the Philippine Constitution?
questions.explanation: Filipino citizens who are at least 18 years old may vote, subject to legal qualifications.

questions.question: Which Philippine law is known as the Data Privacy Act of 2012?
questions.explanation: Republic Act No. 10173 is the Data Privacy Act of 2012.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of the Philippine national budget?
choices: To plan government revenue and spending
To set prices of all goods
questions.explanation: The national budget allocates public resources and authorizes government expenditures for a fiscal year.

questions.question: Which international organization is responsible for coordinating global public health work?
questions.explanation: The World Health Organization directs and coordinates international health work within the UN system.

questions.question: What does ASEAN stand for?
choices: Alliance of South East Asian Nations
Asian Economic and Security Alliance Network
Association of Southern East Asian Neighbors
questions.explanation: ASEAN is the Association of Southeast Asian Nations.

questions.question: Which Philippine law established the Local Government Code of 1991?
questions.explanation: Republic Act No. 7160 is the Local Government Code of 1991.

questions.question: Which document is the supreme law of the Philippines?
questions.explanation: The 1987 Constitution is the fundamental and supreme law of the Republic.

questions.question: Which Philippine agency is primarily responsible for weather forecasts and tropical cyclone warnings?
questions.explanation: PAGASA provides weather forecasts, climate information, and tropical cyclone advisories.

questions.question: Which agency monitors earthquakes and volcanic activity in the Philippines?
questions.explanation: PHIVOLCS monitors volcanic and seismic activity and provides related warnings and information.

questions.question: What does the acronym GDP mean?
questions.explanation: GDP measures the market value of final goods and services produced within a country during a period.

questions.question: Which is an example of renewable energy?
questions.explanation: Solar energy is renewable because it is replenished naturally by sunlight.

questions.question: What is the main function of the ozone layer?
choices: Absorb much of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation
questions.explanation: Stratospheric ozone absorbs much of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation.

questions.question: Which gas do plants absorb from the atmosphere during photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Plants use carbon dioxide and water, with light energy, to produce sugars and release oxygen.

questions.question: Which international agreement focuses on limiting global warming through climate action?
questions.explanation: The Paris Agreement is a global treaty addressing climate change and efforts to limit temperature rise.

questions.question: What is the official currency of Japan?
questions.explanation: Japan's official currency is the yen.

questions.question: Which Philippine institution is the central monetary authority?
questions.explanation: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas is the country's central bank and monetary authority.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the Freedom of Information (FOI) policy in the Philippine executive branch?
choices: Allow access to government information, subject to exceptions
Remove all government records from public view
Give private companies control of public records
questions.explanation: The FOI policy promotes transparency by allowing access to official records, subject to lawful exceptions.

questions.question: Which right protects a person against unreasonable searches and seizures under the Philippine Constitution?
choices: Right against unreasonable searches and seizures
questions.explanation: Article III, Section 2 protects people against unreasonable searches and seizures.

questions.question: Which UN agency focuses on education, science, and culture?
questions.explanation: UNESCO stands for the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization.

questions.question: What does the Philippine acronym NDRRMC refer to?
choices: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council
National Development and Regional Roads Management Commission
National Department for Rescue and Relief Management Council
National Disaster Response and Recovery Medical Center
questions.explanation: NDRRMC coordinates disaster risk reduction and management efforts in the Philippines.

questions.question: Which of the following is a basic principle of the rule of law?
choices: Government officials are above the law
Laws apply equally and are publicly known
Only private citizens must obey laws
questions.explanation: The rule of law requires that everyone, including public officials, is accountable under the law.

questions.question: Which Philippine law is commonly called the Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000?
questions.explanation: Republic Act No. 9003 establishes the country's ecological solid waste management framework.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of a firewall in computer security?
choices: Filter network traffic according to security rules
questions.explanation: A firewall monitors and controls incoming and outgoing network traffic based on defined rules.

questions.question: Which practice best helps protect an online account?
choices: Use a unique strong password and multifactor authentication
questions.explanation: Unique strong passwords and multifactor authentication reduce the risk of account compromise.

questions.question: Piliin ang wastong gamit ng 'ng' at 'nang': 'Tumakbo siya _____ mabilis.'
questions.explanation: 'Nang' ang ginagamit bilang pang-abay na nagpapalakas ng kahulugan ng pandiwang 'tumakbo'. Ang 'ng' ay pantukoy o pang-angkop.

questions.question: Alin ang tamang kahulugan ng salitang 'makulay'?
questions.explanation: 'Makulay' ay nangangahulugang masaya, interesante, at puno ng buhay.

questions.question: Ang wikang pambansa ng Pilipinas ay:
questions.explanation: Ayon sa Saligang Batas ng 1987, ang Filipino ang wikang pambansa ng Pilipinas.

questions.question: Alin sa mga sumusunod ang HINDI pang-uri (adjective) sa Filipino?
questions.explanation: 'Tumakbo' ay isang pandiwa (verb). Ang maganda, mabilis, at mataas ay mga pang-uri.

questions.question: Ang salitang 'maunawain' ay isang halimbawa ng:
questions.explanation: 'Maunawain' ay isang pang-uri (adjective) na nangangahulugang understanding o matiisin.

questions.question: Piliin ang tamang anyo: 'Ang bawat mamamayan _____ may responsibilidad sa bansa.'
questions.explanation: 'Ay may' ang tamang gamit bago ang mga salitang may pantukoy tulad ng 'responsibilidad sa bansa'.

questions.question: Ang tamang pagbabaybay ay:
questions.explanation: Ang tamang pagbabaybay ay 'Pagpapahalaga' — mula sa salitang 'halaga' na may unlapi na 'pagpapa-'.

questions.question: Alin sa mga sumusunod ang pangngalan (noun)?
questions.explanation: 'Kalayaan' ay isang pangngalan na nangangahulugang freedom. Ang iba ay pandiwa at pang-uri.

questions.question: Ano ang kahulugan ng salitang 'mapanlinlang'?
questions.explanation: 'Mapanlinlang' ay nangangahulugang mapandaya o deceptive — isang taong nanlilinlang ng iba.

questions.question: Alin ang tamang pangungusap?
questions.explanation: 'Umalis na siya kahapon' ang tamang pangungusap. Ang 'na' dito ay nagpapahiwatig na natapos na ang kilos.

questions.question: Ang salitang 'magbasa' ay nasa anong uri ng pandiwa?
questions.explanation: 'Magbasa' ay pandiwang palipat (transitive verb) dahil ito ay may tinatanggap na kilos (ang bagay na binabasa).

questions.question: Ano ang tawag sa pagbabago ng anyo ng pandiwa batay sa aspeto ng panahon?
questions.explanation: Ang aspeto ng pandiwa ang nagpapakita kung ang kilos ay naganap na (naganap), nagaganap pa (nagaganap), o magaganap pa (magaganap).

questions.question: Piliin ang wastong salita: 'Ang bata ay _____ sa kanyang guro.'
questions.explanation: 'Gumalang' ang tamang anyo sa naganap na aspeto (nakaraan): ang bata ay gumalang sa kanyang guro.

questions.question: Ang 'Florante at Laura' ay isinulat ni:
questions.explanation: Ang 'Florante at Laura' ay awit (metrical romance) na isinulat ni Francisco Balagtas (Francisco Baltazar).

questions.question: Alin sa mga sumusunod ang halimbawa ng tayutay na simile?
choices: Ang kanyang ngiti ay parang sikat ng araw.
Ang mga bituin ay nagsasayaw sa langit.
Ang hangin ay bumubulong ng mga lihim.
questions.explanation: Ang simile ay paghahambing gamit ang 'parang', 'tulad ng', o 'katulad ng'. 'Parang sikat ng araw' ay simile.

questions.question: Ano ang kahulugan ng idyomang 'nasa hustong gulang'?
choices: Sapat na ang edad at kahinugan
questions.explanation: 'Nasa hustong gulang' ay nangangahulugang ang isang tao ay sapat na ang edad at kahinugan o kapanahunan.

questions.question: Alin ang tamang gamit ng panlaping 'maka-'?
questions.explanation: Ang panlaping 'maka-' ay ginagamit upang ipahiwatig ng pagkakatulad o suporta: makabayan (pro-country), makaagham (pro-science), makabata (pro-youth).

questions.question: Ang salitang 'takipsilim' ay nangangahulugang:
questions.explanation: 'Takipsilim' ay ang oras ng paglubog ng araw — dapit-hapon o kapag nagdidilim na.

questions.question: Ano ang tawag sa mga salitang magkasingkahulugan?
questions.explanation: Ang mga salitang magkasingkahulugan ay tinatawag na synonyms o kasingkahulugan sa Filipino.

questions.question: Piliin ang wastong pangungusap:
choices: Siya ay pumunta sa paaralan ng umaga.
Pumunta siya sa paaralan nang umaga.
Pumunta siya ng paaralan sa umaga.
Siya ay pumunta ng paaralan nang umaga.
questions.explanation: 'Nang umaga' ang tamang gamit bilang pang-abay ng panahon. Ang 'ng' ay hindi ginagamit para sa panahon.

questions.question: Alin ang uri ng pangungusap na 'Maaga na, kaya umalis na kami.'?
questions.explanation: Ito ay tambalang pangungusap (compound sentence) — dalawang sugnay na may pantay na kahalagahan, pinagsama ng 'kaya'.

questions.question: Ano ang tawag sa bahagi ng salita na inilalagay sa simula ng salita?
questions.explanation: Ang unlapi (prefix) ay inilalagay sa simula ng salita, tulad ng 'mag-', 'um-', 'maka-'.

questions.question: Ang salitang 'nagmamahal' ay nasa anong aspeto?
questions.explanation: 'Nagmamahal' ay nasa nagaganap na aspeto (present tense) — ang kilos ay nagaganap sa kasalukuyan.

questions.question: Alin ang tamang baybay?
questions.explanation: Ang tamang baybay ay 'Pananagutan' — nangangahulugang accountability o responsibility.

questions.question: Ang 'Panahon ng Kastila' sa kasaysayan ng Pilipinas ay tumagal ng humigit-kumulang:
questions.explanation: Ang Pilipinas ay nasa ilalim ng pananakop ng Espanya mula 1565 hanggang 1898, humigit-kumulang 333 taon.

questions.question: Ano ang kahulugan ng salitang 'mapagkumbaba'?
questions.explanation: 'Mapagkumbaba' ay nangangahulugang humble — isang taong hindi nagmamataas at kinikilala ang kanyang kakulangan.

questions.question: Piliin ang wastong salita para sa pangungusap: '_______ kami ng masarap na hapunan kagabi.'
questions.explanation: Dahil sa panandang pampanahon na 'kagabi' (naganap na), ang tamang anyo ng pandiwa ay 'nagluto' (aspektong perpektibo).

questions.question: Ano ang kahulugan ng matalinghagang salita na 'balat-sibuyas'?
questions.explanation: Ang idyomang 'balat-sibuyas' ay naglalarawan sa isang taong sobrang sensitibo, madaling masaktan ang damdamin, o madaling maiyak.

questions.question: Piliin ang pangungusap na may tamang gamit ng 'din' o 'rin':
choices: Sasama rin ako sa inyo mamaya.
Sasama din ako sa inyo mamaya.
questions.explanation: Ginagamit ang 'rin' kapag ang sinusundang salita ay nagtatapos sa patinig (a, e, i, o, u) o malapatinig (w, y). Ang 'Sasama' ay nagtatapos sa 'a', kaya 'rin' ang wasto.

questions.question: Ano ang tamang baybay ng salitang hiram mula sa Ingles na 'computer' batay sa kasalukuyang ortograpiyang Filipino?
questions.explanation: Ang karaniwang baybay sa Filipino ng 'computer' ay 'kompyuter', kung saan ang 'c' ay naging 'k' at ang 'u' ay naging 'yu'.

questions.question: Alin sa mga sumusunod ang isang halimbawa ng pang-abay na pamanahon?
questions.explanation: Ang pang-abay na pamanahon ay nagsasaad kung kailan naganap, nagaganap, o magaganap ang kilos ng pandiwa. Ang 'kaninang umaga' ay tumutukoy sa oras/panahon.

questions.question: Sino ang tinaguriang 'Utak ng Katipunan' sa kasaysayan ng Pilipinas?
questions.explanation: Si Emilio Jacinto ang kilala bilang 'Utak ng Katipunan' dahil sa kanyang mga isinulat na alituntunin at gabay para sa samahan, tulad ng Kartilya ng Katipunan.

questions.question: Ano ang kahulugan ng salitang 'nagbabadya' sa pangungusap: 'Ang kanyang mga pahayag ay tila nagbabadya ng magandang kinabukasan.'
questions.explanation: Ang salitang 'nagbabadya' ay nangangahulugang nagpapakita ng senyales, nagbabala, o nagpapahiwatig ng isang bagay na mangyayari.

questions.question: Anong uri ng tayutay ang ginamit sa linya na: 'Sumasayaw ang mga dahon sa hipan ng mahinang hangin.'?
questions.explanation: Ito ay personipikasyon o pagsasatao dahil binibigyan ng katangian ng tao (pagsasayaw) ang mga bagay na walang buhay (dahon).

questions.question: Piliin ang tamang anyo ng panghalip: 'Iabot mo sa _______ ang mga dokumentong nasa mesa.'
questions.explanation: Ang 'akin' ay isang panghalip na paari/paukol na gumagana bilang layon ng preposisyon o direksyon ng kilos sa pangungusap.

questions.question: Alin sa mga sumusunod ang pandiwang nasa aspektong kontemplatibo (magaganap pa lamang)?
